detailed_description: The Keyword Density Checker analyzes pasted text in the browser with the local analyzeKeywordDensity helper. It shows the total word count, a table of up to 20 top single keywords with count, density percentage, and a simple visual bar, plus detected two-word and three-word phrase chips. You can adjust the minimum word length from 1 to 10 and choose whether to exclude common words. The tool does not upload files, calculate TF-IDF or IDF, perform stemming, part-of-speech tagging, LSI analysis, case-sensitive modes, benchmark comparisons, segment charts, or CSV/JSON export.
usage_steps: Paste text into the input textarea.
Set the minimum word length when needed.
Toggle Exclude Common Words to filter or include common terms.
Review the total word count and top keyword table.
Check the two-word and three-word phrase chips when they appear.
usage_examples: Check which words appear most often in a pasted article draft.
Compare keyword density after changing the minimum word length.
Include or exclude common words to see how the top list changes.
Review repeated two-word and three-word phrases in a short content sample.
